title: Gutter Guard Cost per Linear Foot: 2026 Price Factors
body_markdown:
Gutter guard cost per linear foot is not one number. It moves with mesh type, house height, roof pitch, and how much gutter prep the job needs. This page shows what drives a 2026 quote and how to compare bids line by line.


**TL;DR**

- Gutter guard cost per linear foot in 2026 depends on mesh material, stories, roof pitch, and gutter condition.
- Micro-mesh stainless steel costs more per foot than plastic or basic screens, but it is built to keep out shingle grit and needles.
- Compare bids as total linear feet times the per-foot rate, plus separate line items for cleaning and repairs.
- Ask every installer who does the work and whether the warranty transfers to the next owner.


## Why this matters

A quote that says "$X for the house" hides the only figure you can compare: the rate per linear foot. Two bids can look 30% apart and turn out identical once you count the footage, the stories, and what is bundled in.

[CleanGutters Lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) installs surgical stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guards across South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware. The factors below apply to any installer, including us.

## The short answer

There is no honest flat per-foot price for gutter guards in 2026. The rate is set by the product and the house. Any site quoting a single figure without asking about your roof is guessing.

What you can do is calculate the number that matters. Measure the gutter run, multiply by the installer's rate, then add anything not included: cleaning, repairs, and reattaching sagging sections.

## What sets the per-foot rate

Five inputs decide the rate. Each one moves it in a predictable direction.

| Price factor | Effect on per-foot cost | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Mesh material | Higher for stainless steel micro-mesh | Fine stainless mesh blocks shingle grit and pine needles. Plastic and wide screens let debris in. |
| Stories | Higher on two stories and above | Ladder work and crew time rise with height. |
| Roof pitch | Higher on steep roofs | Slower, riskier access means more labor hours. |
| Gutter condition | Extra cost if repairs are needed | Guards must sit on straight, sound, clean gutters. |
| Warranty and installer | Varies | Owner-installed work and transferable warranties are priced in, not free. |

This table is directional. It does not list dollar values because the rate depends on your measured footage and roofline.

## Mesh type: the biggest lever

Mesh is where bids diverge most. Three common categories sit at very different points on the price scale.

- **Plastic or foam inserts:** cheapest per foot. Best for a short-term fix. **Skip** for homes under mature trees.
- **Wide-hole aluminum or steel screens:** mid-range. Larger debris stays out, but shingle grit and seeds pass through. **Hold.**
- **Stainless steel micro-mesh:** highest per foot. Best for tree-heavy lots and homeowners who want to stop cleaning. **Buy.**

CleanGutters Lighting installs LeafBlaster Pro micro-mesh, a surgical stainless steel system. The goal is simple: water goes in, debris stays out. Heavy rain is where cheap guards fail first, so the rated flow matters. Our system is built for 22+ inches of rain per hour.


![Five factors that set the per-foot price of gutter guards](https://gwvckixiegkllthleuyt.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/workspace-article-images-public/d65070d0-5ad4-4897-8b73-aaa803392600/body-41d8ad3c2cb19a1291d2998c0a707b97.jpg)

*Mesh material moves the rate more than any other single input.*


## Stories and roof pitch

A one-story ranch and a three-story colonial with the same gutter length do not cost the same per foot. Height adds ladder setup, safety work, and time. Steep pitch does the same.

If an installer quotes one flat rate for your whole house, ask whether upper-story runs are priced separately. A flat rate usually means the easy runs are subsidizing the hard ones, or the hard ones are being underquoted.

## Gutter condition: the cost nobody mentions up front

Guards do not fix a gutter that is pulling away from the fascia or pitched wrong. Packed gutters must be cleaned before guards go on, and sagging sections must be re-hung or repaired.

Get these as separate line items. That is how you tell a low per-foot rate from a low rate with the real cost pushed into change orders later.

## Warranty and who installs

A lifetime warranty is only worth the price if it covers labor and the product, and if it survives a home sale. CleanGutters Lighting offers transferable lifetime warranties, which matters when you list the house.

Alex installs every job personally, not through subcontractors. Ask any installer you consider the same question: who is on my roof? Subcontracted crews are a common source of loose fastening and missed sections, and the warranty is only as good as the work behind it.

## How to compare two bids

Use the same four steps on every quote.

1. **Get the total linear feet.** Ask for the footage on paper. If two bids show different footage, one of them measured wrong.
2. **Divide the price by footage.** That is your real per-foot rate.
3. **Match the product.** Compare stainless micro-mesh to stainless micro-mesh, never to plastic.
4. **List what is excluded.** Cleaning, repairs, downspouts, and upper-story surcharges.

A bid that wins on step 2 but loses on step 4 is not cheaper.

## Cost over time, not per foot

The per-foot rate is a one-time number. The comparison that matters in 2026 is against what you pay to keep gutters clear without guards: repeated cleanings, ladder risk, and overflow damage to fascia, siding, and foundation.

We do not publish a universal break-even figure, because it depends on tree cover and how often you clean now. Run it on your own house: count cleanings per year, multiply by what you pay per visit, and set that against a guard quote.

## Limits of this page

This page does not give dollar figures per foot. Rates vary by installer, season, and house, and a number copied from a national average would not describe a South Jersey colonial under oaks. The factors and the comparison method are what hold up across quotes.

Per-foot rate, footage, and extras listed line by line.

**[Request a quote](https://cleangutterslighting.com/)**


## FAQ


**How is gutter guard cost per linear foot calculated?**

Total installed price divided by the linear feet of gutter covered. Ask for the footage in writing so you can compare bids on the same basis.

**Why does micro-mesh cost more per foot than screens?**

Stainless steel micro-mesh uses finer material and more precise installation. It blocks shingle grit and needles that wider screens let through.

**Do two-story homes cost more per foot?**

Yes. Upper-story runs take more crew time and safety setup, so many installers price them higher than ground-level runs.

**Is gutter cleaning included in the per-foot price?**

Not by default. Gutters must be clean before guards go on, so ask whether cleaning and repairs are separate line items.

**Should I choose the lowest per-foot rate?**

Only if the product, footage, and exclusions match the other bids. A low rate on a weaker product or with extras billed later is not cheaper.

**Does a gutter guard warranty transfer when I sell my house?**

It depends on the installer. CleanGutters Lighting offers transferable lifetime warranties; confirm the transfer terms in writing with anyone else you consider.

**Where does CleanGutters Lighting install gutter guards?**

South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware. The company has served more than 1,000 homes.


## One last thing

Before you sign anything in 2026, ask each installer one question: what is the footage on my house, and what is the rate per foot? An installer who answers on the spot has measured. One who cannot is quoting a guess.
